title: embelia myrtillus
intro: Embelia myrtillus, commonly known as Indian black pepper, is a plant species in the family Primulaceae. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in reducing fever, relieving pain, and supporting digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Embelia myrtillus include its use in treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, as well as its ability to improve liver function and protect against certain diseases. The bioactive constituents of Embelia myrtillus include alkaloids, phenolic compounds, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
